items.source: See @EnableAsync for usage examples and information on how a default LoadTimeWeaver is selected when this interface is not used.
items.translation: 有关使用示例和当未使用该接口时如何选择默认LoadTimeWeaver的信息，请参阅@EnableAsync。

items.source: Create, configure and return the LoadTimeWeaver instance to be used. Note that it is unnecessary to annotate this method with @Bean because the object returned will automatically be registered as a bean by LoadTimeWeavingConfiguration.loadTimeWeaver()
items.translation: 创建、配置并返回要使用的 LoadTimeWeaver 实例。请注意，无需在此方法上添加 @Bean 注解，因为返回的对象将由 LoadTimeWeavingConfiguration.loadTimeWeaver() 自动注册为 Bean。

items.source: Create, configure and return the LoadTimeWeaver instance to be used.
items.translation: 创建、配置并返回要使用的LoadTimeWeaver实例。
